provenance_quote: such strains translocate the bacterial protein CagA into gastric epithelial cells by a type IV secretion system, encoded by the cag pathogenicity island.
notes: DOI 10.1126/science.287.5457.1497 (Odenbreit 2000 Science, Translocation of H. pylori CagA into Gastric Epithelial Cells by Type IV Secretion) resolves via Crossref; quote is the paper own statement. UniProt P55980 = CagA, H. pylori 26695, OrderedLocusName HP_0547 (RefSeq HP_RS02695); active reviewed entry. ss_type T4SS correct.

provenance_quote: a large group of effectors (Lpg0103/VipF, Leg0208/LegK4, Lpg0437/Ceg14, Lpg1368/Lgt1, Lpg1488/Lgt3, Lpg2504/SidI, and Lpg2862/Lgt2) shown to manipulate eukaryotic protein translation
notes: DOI 10.1038/s44320-024-00076-z (PMID 39562741, Patel 2024 Mol Syst Biol) resolves; atlas covers 368 L. pneumophila Dot/Icm translocated effectors and names Lpg0437/Ceg14 as a translation-manipulating effector. uniprot blank (-) so na. Ceg14 is an established Dot/Icm effector. ss_type T4SS correct.

provenance_quote: The effector proteins (CBU0021, CBU0937, CBU1823, CBU1825 and CBU2013) were mainly associated with autophagy.
notes: DOI 10.1371/journal.ppat.1010660 (PMID 35816513, Fu 2022 PLoS Pathog) resolves but is about effector CirB=CBU0425 (only CirB translocation validated by beta-lactamase assay). CBU0937 appears ONLY in a host-interactor PPI list associated with autophagy; no demonstration that CBU0937 is itself T4SS-translocated. UniProt Q83D09=CBU_0937 is uncharacterized UPF0422 family; no CirD synonym in UniProt and no PubMed hit designates CBU0937 as CirD or a Dot/Icm-translocated effector. Identity fields match but the secretion-effector claim lacks a primary translocation reference. accession Q83D09 active.

provenance_quote: the VirB/D4 system is also involved in the translocation of several effector proteins, including VirE2, VirE3 and VirF into the host cell cytoplasm.
notes: DOI 10.1371/journal.ppat.1003948 (PMID 24626239) resolves; despite its VBP-dimerization title, the abstract explicitly states VirE3 is translocated into the host by the VirB/D4 T4SS (quote verbatim from abstract). UniProt P08061 is the reviewed canonical entry VIRE3_AGRFC (gene virE3, A. fabrum C58). NOTE: P08061 annotated as an 83-aa VirE locus 9 kDa virulence protein; a separate longer virE3-named entry (A0A2Z2PK47, 684 aa) also exists, so the historically-studied larger VirE3 effector may map to a different accession, but UniProt itself assigns the VIRE3 reviewed identifier to P08061 so uniprot_ok=yes; flagged for curator. ss_type T4SS correct.

provenance_quote: These translocated effector proteins (Beps) A-G are encoded together with the VirB system and the T4S coupling protein VirD4 on a Bartonella-specific pathogenicity island.
notes: DOI 10.1073/pnas.0406796102 (PMID 15642951, Schulein 2005 PNAS, A bipartite signal mediates the transfer of T4SS substrates of B. henselae into human cells) resolves; Beps incl BepA are VirB/D4 T4SS substrates. UniProt Q6G2A9 = BepA (protein adenylyltransferase), B. henselae Houston-1, annotated Translocated into the host cell via the type IV secretion system. ss_type T4SS correct.

provenance_quote: translocation of BtpA-CyaA and CyaA-BtpB was clearly reduced in a virB genetic background, indicating that delivery of both proteins is dependent on the T4SS
notes: DOI 10.3389/fcimb.2013.00028 (PMID 23847770, Salcedo 2013) confirms BtpB is a Brucella TIR effector translocated by the VirB T4SS. BUT the paper states BtpB = BAB1_0756, whereas ledger uniprot Q2YNA0 = BAB1_0782 DUF2069 domain-containing protein (NOT a TIR protein, not BtpB) = wrong accession. Correct B. abortus 2308 BtpB accession is Q2YN91 (UniProt TIR domain-containing protein, BAB1_0756). Ledger locus BAB_RS19660 is also inconsistent with BAB1_0756; new_locus_tag should be BAB1_0756. Effector real and secreted, so fix not drop.

provenance_quote: identification of the proteins encoded by BAB1_1652 (VceA) and BR1038/BAB1_1058 (VceC) as novel protein substrates of the T4SS.
notes: DOI 10.1111/j.1365-2958.2008.06487.x (PMID 18761695, De Jong 2008 Mol Microbiol, VceA and VceC translocated into macrophages by the Brucella type IV secretion system) resolves; VceC is a confirmed Brucella T4SS substrate. uniprot blank (-) so na; ledger locus BAB_RS26945 / genome NC_007624.1 (chr II) consistent with VceC being a BR1038/BAB2 locus. ss_type T4SS correct.

provenance_quote: we screened a genomic DNA library of A. phagocytophilum for effectors of the type IV secretion system by a bacterial two-hybrid system, using A. phagocytophilum VirD4 as bait. A hypothetical protein was identified as a putative effector, hereby named Anaplasma translocated substrate 1 (Ats-1)
notes: DOI 10.1371/journal.ppat.1000774 (PMID 20174550, Niu 2010 PLoS Pathog) resolves; abstract contains the citation_quote verbatim and establishes Ats-1 as a T4SS effector translocated across the inclusion membrane. UniProt Q2GJL5 = Anaplasma Translocated Substrate 1 (Ats-1), A. phagocytophilum HZ, locus APH_0859 (RefSeq APH_RS03430). ss_type T4SS correct.
